injuries.name: KeAndre Lambert-Smith
injuries.headline: KeAndre Lambert-Smith (hamstring) limited participant Wednesday
injuries.comment: The team recently opened up Lambert-Smith's 21-day practice window. He was able to participate in a limited fashion on Wednesday, and there's a chance that he will suit up and play in Week 6, though we won't know if that will be the case or not until later on in the week.

injuries.name: Brenen Thompson
injuries.headline: Brenen Thompson (quad) listed as limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: Thompson was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday. If he's active in Week 6, he could see more work than usual with Ladd McConkey (foot), Tre Harris' (hamstring), and Quentin Johnston (chest) all uncertain to play for the Chargers.

injuries.name: Marquez Valdes-Scantling
injuries.headline: Marquez Valdes-Scantling (rib) limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: The veteran wasn't able to log a full practice on Wednesday, as he was left limited by a rib issue of some kind. He remains off of the fantasy radar moving forward, regardless of his injury status heading into Week 6.

injuries.name: Ladd McConkey
injuries.headline: Ladd McConkey (foot) officially limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: McConkey was unable to see any real action last week due to his foot issue. He was able to practice on Wednesday to start the week this week, but he remained limited due to the same injury. He may play through it in Week 6, but it's hard for fantasy managers to trust starting him at this point in the season, even if his health is improving.

injuries.name: Charlie Kolar
injuries.headline: Charlie Kolar (arm) logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: The veteran tight end made his return to the lineup in Week 4 after missing a couple of weeks with a forearm injury. He looked good and is now a full participant at practice, so fantasy managers can safely speculate that he is back to close health at this point.

injuries.name: Quentin Johnston
injuries.headline: Quentin Johnston (chest) limited at practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Johnston was not able to play last week due to a chest injury that he's dealing with. He was able to practice on Wednesday, however, which is a good sign that he will be back for Week 6. If he's active, he may see more work than usual if Tre' Harris (hamstring) or Ladd McConkey (foot) are ruled out for Sunday's game.

injuries.name: Tyler Guyton
injuries.headline: Tyler Guyton (back) logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: The young offensive lineman was able to practice in full on Wednesday, which puts him on track to be 100% healthy for Week 6. That's good news for Dallas' offense ahead of a matchup against the Packers this week.

injuries.name: Joey Porter Jr.
injuries.headline: Joey Porter Jr. (ankle) listed as limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: Porter was left limited at practice on Wednesday due to an ankle issue of some kind that he's dealing with. It's unclear if it will affect his availability for Week 6 or not, but we should know more sometime within the next day or two.

injuries.name: Savion Williams
injuries.headline: Savion Williams (ankle) considered limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: Williams was able to practice on Wednesday, although he remained limited due to an ankle issue. His status for Week 6 is undetermined at this point, but either way he remains off of the fantasy radar for the time being.

injuries.name: Lukas Van Ness
injuries.headline: Lukas Van Ness (shoulder) logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Van Ness has been dealing with this shoulder injury for a while, but he was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Wednesday, meaning that it should be a non-issue for him moving forward. Green Bay's defense will benefit from him being at full health.

injuries.name: Jacob Monk
injuries.headline: Jacob Monk (quad) limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: Monk was a limited participant on Wednesday due to his nagging quad issue. He may play in Week 6, however, which would be great news for an injury-riddled Packers' offensive line.

injuries.name: Colby Parkinson
injuries.headline: Colby Parkinson (shoulder) limited at practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: The veteran is still dealing with his shoulder issue and was limited on Wednesday as a result. He seems likely to play through it in Week 6, however, and will see more work than usual with Terrance Ferguson (ankle) out and Davis Allen (foot) trending towards being sidelined for the Rams.

injuries.name: Emmanuel Pregnon
injuries.headline: Emmanuel Pregnon (toe) limited participant Wednesday
injuries.comment: Jacksonville's starting lineman is uncertain to play in Week 6. He was limited on Wednesday due to a toe issue, and if it leaves him sidelined on Sunday, the Jaguars' offensive line will be weaker than usual ahead of a matchup against the Texans.

injuries.name: Cole Van Lanen
injuries.headline: Cole Van Lanen (knee) limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: To no surprise, Van Lanen was limited at another practice due to his ongoing knee issue. The team has made a habit of limiting his workload in practice, but he has been playing through the injury and should be able to do so again in Week 6, barring setbacks.

injuries.name: Nate Boerkircher
injuries.headline: Nate Boerkircher (back) listed as limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: The rookie is managing a back issue of some kind and was left limited at the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday as a result. He's not fantasy relevant at this point, so his potential absence in Week 6 wouldn't have a big impact for fantasy purposes.

injuries.name: Za'Darius Smith
injuries.headline: Za'Darius Smith (concussion/neck) limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: Smith is still going through the NFL's concussion protocols, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, which is a good sign for his availability for Week 6. Atlanta's defense will see a nice boost if he's available to play this week.

injuries.name: Michael Penix Jr.
injuries.headline: Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Penix injured his ribs last week, but it doesn't seem to be a serious issue, as he was able to practice in full on Wednesday and told reporters that he will be 'good to play' this week. He should be available to start for the Falcons, which is great news for the fantasy value of Drake London, Bijan Robinson, and all of Atlanta's skill-position players this week.

injuries.name: Dee Alford
injuries.headline: Dee Alford (ankle) limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: Alford was sidelined in Week 5 due to an ankle injury, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, which puts him on track to make his return in Week 6. Buffalo's defense will see a nice boost to their secondary if he's active against the Raiders.

injuries.name: Joshua Palmer
injuries.headline: Joshua Palmer (shoulder) limited participant Wednesday
injuries.comment: A shoulder injury left Palmer limited at practice on Wednesday. It's not considered a serious issue, however, so it isn't likely to leave him sidelined in Week 6. He would see more work in Sunday's game in the off-chance that DJ Moore (shoulder) is unable to suit up for Buffalo.

injuries.name: Ty Johnson
injuries.headline: Ty Johnson (hamstring) limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: Johnson was left limited at practice on Wednesday due to a hamstring injury that he's still managing. It shouldn't affect his availability for Week 6, however, unless he suffers a setback at some point in the week.

injuries.name: Ashton Jeanty
injuries.headline: Ashton Jeanty (foot) logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: There has been some recent speculation that Jeanty is not at full health, but while he is listed on Las Vegas' injury report, he was able to practice in full on Wednesday and should be good to go for Week 6. Fantasy managers should continue to start him, but after a slow start to the season, they should have tempered expectations for his efficiency for the foreseeable future.

injuries.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
injuries.headline: Dont'e Thornton Jr. (hamstring) logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Thornton is still in his 21-day practice window, but he seems to be very close to a return and was able to practice in full on Wednesday. It looks likely that he will be activated for Week 6, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

injuries.name: Brock Bowers
injuries.headline: Brock Bowers (knee) limited at practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Bowers was limited at Wednesday's practice, which doesn't come as a surprise, as the team has made a habit out of limiting his workload early in the week. He should be available to play in Week 6 and will remain a top-tier fantasy option moving forward.

injuries.name: Chazz Surratt
injuries.headline: Chazz Surratt (calf) ruled out Thursday
injuries.comment: Surratt is unable to go on a short week for Seattle.

injuries.name: Drake Thomas
injuries.headline: Drake Thomas (ankle) ruled out Thursday
injuries.comment: Thomas is unable to go on a short week. Tyrice Knight will start for Thomas.

injuries.name: Zach Charbonnet
injuries.headline: Zach Charbonnet (knee) ruled out for Thursday
injuries.comment: Charbonnet remains hopeful to make his season debut next week against the Chiefs.

injuries.name: Riley Moss
injuries.headline: Riley Moss (ribs) listed questionable for Thursday
injuries.comment: Moss was limited in practice all week. Pat Surtain II and Talanoa Hufanga were both ruled out.

injuries.name: Caleb Williams
injuries.headline: Caleb Williams (hamstring) officially logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: This confirms what Ben Johnson told reporters earlier in the day on Wednesday. Williams will have a chance to return for Sunday's game against the Falcons.

injuries.name: Kyler Gordon
injuries.headline: Kyler Gordon (calf) logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Gordon will have a chance to be activated from the PUP list for Sunday's game against the Falcons.

injuries.name: Tyrique Stevenson Sr.
injuries.headline: Tyrique Stevenson Sr. (hip) limited in practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Stevenson is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Falcons.

injuries.name: Andrew Mukuba
injuries.headline: Andrew Mukuba (shoulder) logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Mukuba is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

injuries.name: Fred Johnson
injuries.headline: Fred Johnson (knee) logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Johnson is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

injuries.name: Jalen Hurts
injuries.headline: Jalen Hurts (calf) logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Hurts fantasy value will largely be dependant on the health of DeVonta Smith and Saquon Barkley. He is a risky start for fantasy managers as of now given his recent struggles.

injuries.name: Jalen Carter
injuries.headline: Jalen Carter (wrist) logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Carter will be a full-go for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

injuries.name: Jihaad Campbell
injuries.headline: Jihaad Campbell (knee/wrist) logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Campbell is on track to be a full-go for Wednesday’s game against the Panthers.

injuries.name: Zack Baun
injuries.headline: Zack Baun (shoulder) logs full practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Baun is on track to be a full-go for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

injuries.name: Dontayvion Wicks
injuries.headline: Dontayvion Wicks (hamstring) limited in practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Wicks is on the injury report with a hamstring issue. He should be good to go for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

injuries.name: Eli Stowers
injuries.headline: Eli Stowers (quad) limited in practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Stowers had his practice window opened on Wednesday. His status is up in the air to return this weekend.

injuries.name: Tyler Steen
injuries.headline: Tyler Steen (shoulder) limited in practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Steen will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

injuries.name: Jonathan Greenard
injuries.headline: Jonathan Greenard (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Greenard will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

injuries.name: Marcus Epps
injuries.headline: Marcus Epps (groin) limited in practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Epps will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

injuries.name: Landon Dickerson
injuries.headline: Landon Dickerson (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Dickerson had his practice window opened on Wednesday. His status is up in the air to return this weekend.

injuries.name: Grant Calcaterra
injuries.headline: Grant Calcaterra (back) limited in practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Calcaterra had his practice window opened on Wednesday. His status is up in the air to return this weekend.

injuries.name: Hollywood Brown
injuries.headline: Hollywood Brown (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Brown is continuing to work his way back from an ankle injury. He remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.

injuries.name: Jakorian Bennett
injuries.headline: Jakorian Bennett (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Bennett had his practice window opened on Wednesday. His status is up in the air to return this weekend.

injuries.name: Pat Surtain II
injuries.headline: Pat Surtain II (ankle) out for Thursday night against Seattle
injuries.comment: Surtain will miss yet another game, but with the Bronco’s having a mini bye week, hopefully he can return for Week 7. Denver will have to make it work without him.

injuries.name: Theo Johnson
injuries.headline: Theo Johnson (neck) limited in practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Johnson remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.

injuries.name: Kenyon Sadiq
injuries.headline: Kenyon Sadiq (concussion) listed as limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: The rookie is currently going through the NFL's concussion protocols and was limited at New York's practice on Wednesday as a result. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on all updates about his health throughout the week.

injuries.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
injuries.headline: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) officially limited Wednesday
injuries.comment: The rookie has been out for over four weeks due to an ankle injury, but he recently had his practice window opened up and was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday. It looks like he will be back in the lineup in the near future, although it's unclear whether or not his return will come in Week 6.

injuries.name: Darnell Mooney
injuries.headline: Darnell Mooney (neck) limited in practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Mooney remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

injuries.name: Marlon Humphrey
injuries.headline: Marlon Humphrey (calf/hamstring) limited in practice Wednesday
injuries.comment: Humphrey should be good to go for Sunday's game against the Browns.
